label: GEOINT New Zealand presents its military topographic map programme
summary: At GeoCart 2016, William Mortimer described GNZ’s contribution to the Multinational Geospatial Co-Production Programme, including 1:50,000 data production for the South West Pacific and its refinement into military topographic maps.

sources.label: William Mortimer, GEOINT New Zealand’s 1:50,000 Military Topographic Map Production, GeoCart 2016
